groups.name: 区域与机构
groups.blurb: 按地区与观测发布主体追踪：地球哪一片、由谁在测和在说
groups.blurbEn: Track by region and by the agency that publishes the observations: which part of the planet, measured and reported by whom.

groups.name: 自然与人文领域
groups.blurb: 按地理领域深挖：灾害与气候、水系与地貌、城市与产业、地理信息系统与空间数据……
groups.blurbEn: Dig into one field of geography: hazards and climate, rivers and landforms, cities and industry, GIS and spatial data…

groups.name: 内容与题材
groups.blurb: 按内容形态浏览：灾害速报、观测数据、区划政策、研究发现、技术发布与影像图集……
groups.blurbEn: Browse by content type: hazard bulletins, observation data, zoning and policy, research findings, technology releases, imagery galleries…

topics.name: 青藏高原
topics.definition: 青藏高原及其边缘山系：亚洲水塔的冰川与冻土、隆升与强震、高原季风与生态屏障变化的统一观察单元。
topics.definitionEn: The Tibetan Plateau and its marginal mountain ranges: a single unit for observing the glaciers and permafrost of Asia's water tower, uplift and strong earthquakes, and the plateau monsoon and a changing ecological barrier.

topics.name: 北极与北冰洋
topics.definition: 北极海冰、格陵兰冰盖与新增航道：全球增暖放大最明显、几乎完全依赖卫星与浮标观测的一片区域。
topics.definitionEn: Arctic sea ice, the Greenland Ice Sheet and new shipping routes: the region where global warming is amplified most strongly, and one observed almost entirely by satellites and buoys.

topics.name: 环太平洋火山地震带
topics.definition: 环绕太平洋的板块俯冲边界：全球约九成大地震与多数活火山集中于此，也是海啸预警的主战场。
topics.definitionEn: The plate subduction boundary that encircles the Pacific: about 90% of the world's large earthquakes and most of its active volcanoes are concentrated here, and it is the main arena for tsunami warning.

topics.name: 中国科学院
topics.definition: 中国科学院：国内地理学、湖泊与湿地、冰川冻土与区域可持续研究最集中的科研体系，也是本站研究/发现条目的主要机构来源之一。
topics.definitionEn: The Chinese Academy of Sciences: the biggest concentration of research in China on geography, lakes and wetlands, glaciers and permafrost, and regional sustainability. It is also one of the main institutional sources for Research & discovery items on this site.

topics.name: 欧洲空间局
topics.definition: 欧洲空间局（ESA）：哥白尼哨兵系列之外另一大对地观测与深空任务出口，气候卫星数据、导航与电信研究的一手发布源。
topics.definitionEn: The European Space Agency (ESA): besides the Copernicus Sentinel series, another major outlet for Earth observation and deep-space missions, and a first-hand source for climate satellite data and for navigation and telecommunications research.

topics.name: 中国地震台网中心
topics.definition: 中国地震台网中心（CENC）：中国大陆地震的正式速报与台网测定震级的权威出口，国内官方灾害信息适配的主要锚点。
topics.definitionEn: China Earthquake Networks Center (CENC): the authoritative outlet for formal rapid reports on mainland China earthquakes and for network-determined magnitudes, and the main anchor for aligning official Chinese disaster information.

topics.name: USGS 美国地质调查局
topics.definition: 美国地质调查局：全球地震速报目录、滑坡与地质灾害评估、地球资源与地形数据的头号一手来源，常被用来独立核验震级与位置。
topics.definitionEn: The U.S. Geological Survey: the top first-hand source for global earthquake catalogs and rapid reports, landslide and geohazard assessments, and Earth resource and topographic data. It is often used to independently verify magnitude and location.

topics.name: 中国气象局
topics.definition: 中国气象局及中央气象台：国内台风路径预报、暴雨与高温预警、气候业务通报的官方发布方。
topics.definitionEn: The China Meteorological Administration and the National Meteorological Center: the official issuers of typhoon track forecasts, rainstorm and heat warnings, and operational climate bulletins for China.

topics.name: NOAA 美国海洋大气管理局
topics.definition: 美国国家海洋和大气管理局：热带气旋路径与强度、海表温度与厄尔尼诺监测、气象卫星影像的公开发布方。
topics.definitionEn: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration: a public issuer of tropical cyclone track and intensity information, sea surface temperature and El Niño monitoring, and weather satellite imagery.

topics.name: NASA 地球观测
topics.definition: NASA 的地球科学项目：卫星影像、气候变化与灾害遥感图件最集中的开放出处，公众看到的“地球照片”多来自这里。
topics.definitionEn: NASA's Earth science programs: the most concentrated open outlet for satellite imagery and for remote-sensing images of climate change and disasters. Many of the pictures of Earth that the public sees come from here.

topics.name: 哥白尼地球观测计划
topics.definition: 欧盟哥白尼计划：Sentinel 系列卫星影像与应急制图服务的开放出口，多数可免费商用的地球观测数据由它提供。
topics.definitionEn: The EU's Copernicus program: an open outlet for Sentinel satellite imagery and emergency mapping services, and the provider of most Earth observation data that is free to use commercially.

topics.name: 世界气象组织
topics.definition: 世界气象组织：温度、降水等天气气候纪录的国际确认方，也制定台风命名规则与全球数据交换制度。
topics.definitionEn: The World Meteorological Organization: the international body that confirms weather and climate records such as temperature and precipitation, and that sets typhoon naming rules and the system for global data exchange.

topics.name: IPCC
topics.definition: 政府间气候变化专门委员会：以评估报告汇总全球气候研究并给出结论可信度分级，是媒体报道气候结论时的权威依据。
topics.definitionEn: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change: it brings global climate research together in assessment reports and rates the confidence of its conclusions, and it is the authority news media cite when they report climate findings.

topics.name: OpenStreetMap
topics.definition: OpenStreetMap：志愿者共建的开放地图数据库，许多专题图、导航底图与人道主义制图项目的数据底座。
topics.definitionEn: OpenStreetMap: an open map database built by volunteers, and the data foundation for many thematic maps, navigation basemaps and humanitarian mapping projects.

topics.name: 联合国粮农组织
topics.nameEn: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
topics.definition: 联合国粮农组织：全球土壤、土地利用、作物产量与粮食安全的统计与制图出口，世界土壤资源参考库的维护方。
topics.definitionEn: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations: an outlet for global statistics and maps on soils, land use, crop yields and food security, and the maintainer of the world soil resources reference database.

topics.name: 地震
topics.definition: 岩石圈应力突然释放造成的地面震动，读一条震情要同时看震级、震源深度、震中位置与地震触发的次生灾害。
topics.definitionEn: Ground shaking caused by the sudden release of stress in the lithosphere. Reading an earthquake report means looking at magnitude, focal depth, epicenter location and the secondary hazards the quake triggers.

topics.name: 火山
topics.definition: 岩浆活动造成的喷发、火山灰扩散与熔岩流，既是最具破坏力的地理灾害之一，也是观察地球内部最直接的窗口。
topics.definitionEn: Eruptions, ash dispersal and lava flows caused by magmatic activity: among the most destructive geographic hazards, and also the most direct window into Earth's interior.

topics.name: 台风与气旋
topics.definition: 生成于热带洋面的强气旋系统，按海域称台风、飓风或气旋，核心信息是路径、中心风力、移动速度与风暴潮风险。
topics.definitionEn: Intense cyclonic systems that form over tropical oceans and are called typhoons, hurricanes or cyclones depending on the basin. The core facts are track, wind strength at the center, forward speed and storm surge risk.

topics.name: 气候异常
topics.definition: 偏离常年气候平均态的暖、冷、干、湿极端事件，如破纪录高温、持续干旱与异常暴雨——气候变化的日常表征。
topics.definitionEn: Warm, cold, dry and wet extremes that depart from the long-term climate average: record heat, prolonged drought and unusually heavy rain. These are how climate change shows up day to day.

topics.name: 河流与流域
topics.definition: 以分水岭为界的淡水系统：流量与汛期、泥沙与河道变迁、跨行政区用水分配，决定流域内城市、农业与生态的格局。
topics.definitionEn: Freshwater systems bounded by drainage divides: discharge and flood season, sediment and channel change, and water allocation across administrative boundaries together determine the pattern of cities, farmland and ecosystems in a basin.

topics.name: 地貌与地表过程
topics.definition: 地表形态及其成因：构造抬升与流水、风力、冰川的侵蚀堆积如何塑造高原、平原与峡谷，并以滑坡等形式不断改写它。
topics.definitionEn: The shape of the land and what makes it: how tectonic uplift and erosion and deposition by water, wind and ice build plateaus, plains and gorges, and keep reshaping them through landslides and other processes.

topics.name: 冰川与冻土
topics.definition: 以冰和冻结土体形式储存的淡水圈，包括山岳冰川、冰盖、海冰与多年冻土，对增暖响应滞后但消退后难以逆转。
topics.definitionEn: The part of the freshwater system stored as ice and frozen ground: mountain glaciers, ice sheets, sea ice and permafrost. It responds slowly to warming, but once it retreats the change is hard to reverse.

topics.name: 海洋与海岸
topics.definition: 海温、洋流、海平面与海岸线的变化，关系渔场与港口布局、岛国存续，也决定台风能从洋面取走多少能量。
topics.definitionEn: Sea temperature, currents, sea level and coastlines change. These shifts shape fisheries and port layout, bear on the survival of island nations, and set how much energy a typhoon can draw from the sea.

topics.name: 生态与植被
topics.definition: 植被类型、生物多样性与生态系统服务的空间分布，以及退化、恢复与保护地管理如何改变地表面貌。
topics.definitionEn: Where vegetation types, biodiversity and ecosystem services are distributed, and how degradation, restoration and management of protected areas change the surface of the land.

topics.name: 土壤与土地退化
topics.definition: 土壤类型、耕地质量与土地退化的分布：荒漠化、黑土变薄与污染地块，是粮食安全与生态问题的共同底盘。
topics.definitionEn: The distribution of soil types, cropland quality and land degradation: desertification, thinning black soil and contaminated plots lie beneath both food security and ecological problems.

topics.name: 城市化与城市地理
topics.definition: 人口向城市集聚的过程与城市内部空间结构：城市群、通勤圈、旧城更新与城市热岛如何叠加成一张空间账本。
topics.definitionEn: How people gather into cities, and how space is organized inside them: urban agglomerations, commuting sheds, old-town renewal and urban heat islands add up to one spatial ledger.

topics.name: 人口与迁移
topics.definition: 人口总量、结构与空间分布的变化，以及为就业、环境或安全而发生的迁移、回流与乡村人口流失。
topics.definitionEn: Changes in population size, structure and distribution, plus migration for work, environment or safety, return migration and the loss of rural population.

topics.name: 产业与经济地理
topics.definition: 产业为什么落在某处：资源、劳动力、运输成本与市场距离如何决定区域分工、产业转移与经济走廊的走向。
topics.definitionEn: Why industry settles where it does: resources, labor, transport cost and distance to market decide regional specialization, industrial relocation and the direction of economic corridors.

topics.name: 交通与枢纽
topics.definition: 铁路、公路、港口、机场与管道构成的网络如何压缩时空距离、决定枢纽城市的兴衰与贸易通道归属。
topics.definitionEn: How networks of rail, road, ports, airports and pipelines shrink distance and time, and decide which hub cities rise or fall and who controls trade routes.

topics.name: 行政区划与边界
topics.definition: 国家与地方的区划设置和边界调整：撤县设区、设市、界线变更，会直接改写统计口径、规划权限与地图内容。
topics.definitionEn: How national and local divisions are set and boundaries adjusted: converting a county into a district, establishing a city or shifting a boundary directly rewrites statistical definitions, planning authority and map content.

topics.name: 政治地理与地缘格局
topics.definition: 空间与权力的关系：边界、海峡、通道与资源分布如何成为国家间博弈的筹码，并投射到航运、能源与迁移之上。
topics.definitionEn: The relation between space and power: how borders, straits, corridors and resource distribution become bargaining chips between states, and are projected onto shipping, energy and migration.

topics.name: 能源与矿产
topics.definition: 化石能源、水电、风光与矿产的空间分布和开发条件，决定区域财富、电网走向与出口通道的政治敏感度。
topics.definitionEn: Where fossil fuels, hydropower, wind and solar, and minerals are found and how easily they can be developed. That decides regional wealth, the direction of power grids and how politically sensitive export routes are.

topics.name: 遥感与卫星影像
topics.definition: 从卫星与航空平台在不接触目标的前提下获取地表信息，是大范围变化检测、灾害评估与制图最主要的数据来源。
topics.definitionEn: Reading the ground from satellites and aircraft without touching the target. It is the main source of data for detecting change over large areas, assessing disasters and making maps.

topics.name: 卫星导航与定位
topics.definition: 以北斗、GPS 等星座完成位置与时间测定，厘米级高精度定位已成为测绘、形变监测与野外考察的基础设施。
topics.definitionEn: Fixing position and time with constellations such as BeiDou and GPS. Centimeter-level positioning is now basic infrastructure for surveying, deformation monitoring and field expeditions.

topics.name: GIS 与空间分析
topics.definition: 在计算机中存储、叠加并统计分析地理数据的方法，选址论证、流域划分与灾害风险区划都由它完成。
topics.definitionEn: Methods for storing, overlaying and statistically analyzing geographic data on a computer. Site selection, watershed delineation and disaster risk zoning all run on it.

topics.name: 地图与制图
topics.definition: 按投影与符号规则把地表画成图：比例尺、坐标系与配色决定读者能否正确比较距离、面积与密度。
topics.definitionEn: Drawing the ground as a map under rules of projection and symbol: scale, coordinate system and color decide whether readers can compare distance, area and density correctly.

topics.name: 灾害事件速报
topics.definition: 以具体灾害事件为对象的即时信息：测定参数、预警与响应级别、灾情统计与处置进展的时间线记录。
topics.definitionEn: Immediate information on a specific hazard event: measured parameters, warning and response levels, damage statistics and a timeline of the response.

topics.name: 观测与数据发布
topics.definition: 观测机构定期或即时放出的成果：台网目录、卫星影像、气候监测通报与数据集更新，是可靠度最高的一类信息。
topics.definitionEn: What observation agencies release on a schedule or as it happens: network catalogs, satellite imagery, climate monitoring bulletins and dataset updates. The most reliable kind of information.

topics.name: 区划规划与政策
topics.definition: 与空间有关的政府动作：区划变更、国土空间规划、保护区设立与设防标准调整，往往改动一个地区的长期变量。
topics.definitionEn: Government action that concerns space: boundary changes, territorial spatial planning, new protected areas and revised defense standards. These often change a region's long-term variables.

topics.name: 研究与科学发现
topics.definition: 地理学研究成果：论文、考察报告与模型结论，判断时看数据来源、样本尺度与方法能否支撑得起结论。
topics.definitionEn: Results of geography research: papers, expedition reports and model conclusions. To judge one, ask whether the data source, sample scale and method can support the claim.

topics.name: 技术与软件
topics.definition: 地理信息工具与平台的更新：软件版本、算法模型、卫星载荷与测绘设备的新品发布与能力变化。
topics.definitionEn: Updates to geospatial tools and platforms: new software versions, algorithm models, satellite payloads and surveying equipment, and what each can now do.

topics.name: 考察与发现记
topics.definition: 第一视角的实地记录：科考航次、极地与登山、剖面与路线描述，把观测数据和现场体验写在一起。
topics.definitionEn: First-person records from the field: research cruises, polar and mountain travel, transects and route descriptions that put measurements and lived experience in one account.

topics.name: 影像与图集
topics.definition: 以图为主的选题：卫星对比影像、灾前灾后图件与空间数据可视化，一张合适的图往往胜过一段说明。
topics.definitionEn: Image-led stories: before-and-after satellite views, pre- and post-disaster maps and spatial data visualizations. One well-chosen image often does more than a paragraph.
